prompt:
Photograph of a low, sleek single-masted Caribbean sloop of the 1670s
with a flush deck and a small square transom: one tall mast raked aft
with a large gaff mainsail on a long boom, two triangular jibs on a
long, nearly level bowsprit, a small square topsail high on the mast, a
bare cedar hull with a black wale and a handful of small cannon along
the rail, under sail at sea, seen from low over the water, her bow to
the left and a little towards us, a blue sea with white crests and the
open sea running to the horizon all round her and a sky of soft even
blue with a few white clouds, a natural photograph with no frame, no
border and no circle. Historical reenactment photography, sharp focus,
realistic. The whole ship is built of planked wood: no tower, nothing of
stone.
